title: Tine
description: Metadata of a Tine, a mod loaded by Atlantis' Trident loader from config/atlantis/trident. Placed at the root of the Tine's jar as tine.json.

id.description: Unique mod ID. Must not clash with any other Tine or modloader mod.

version.description: Semantic version of the Tine, e.g. 1.0.0 or 1.2.0-beta.1.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the ID.

order.description: Load order among Tines that don't depend on each other. Lower loads earlier.

depends.description: Required Tines or modloader mods, by ID, with the versions they must match. Tine dependencies always load first.

range.description: Space-separated constraints that must all match, with || between alternatives. Constraints are *, a bare version (exact), or a version prefixed by =, >, >=, <, <=, ~ (same minor) or ^ (same major).
